scope: Product fixes deployed; signed Apple Silicon installer upgraded through the actual public updater. Real production browser, packaged Bridge and Ableton tested in a disposable set. This is not a guarantee that every feature or installation environment is defect-free.

bridge.notarization: Accepted; ticket stapled and disk image checksum verified
passed: Public HTTPS download of all 310740895 bytes matches the release SHA-256
Real updater downloaded, verified, replaced and relaunched the installed app from 1.3.7 to 1.3.8
Saved sign-in reconnects without entering a password
Actual Disconnect and Let's make music buttons disconnect and reconnect; browser status agrees
Connected email and password fields have readable dark backgrounds; setup controls and version footer are visible
Browser removes the obsolete Bridge update prompt after the new version connects
Bad checksum leaves the previous application untouched; fresh-copy Gatekeeper and signature checks pass
Packaged real four-stem separation, resource-tracker dispatch and production HTTPS/WebSocket checks pass
Clean upstream AbletonOSC archive 0ca68214bd62c9b5cb641ca34006cfd70ba94430 installed through the actual setup button and used inside Live for production chat actions
bridge.signed_in_password_behavior: Credentials are intentionally disabled while signed in, including after manual Disconnect. Sign out makes them editable. The disabled password field remains visible; an account-only signed-in layout is a remaining usability improvement.

fixed: Transient 5xx responses are no longer described as invalid model configuration
Configured same-provider fallback handles 500, 502, 503, 504 and 529 before any tool dispatch; the active fallback is retained for the rest of that production loop
Usage records identify the model that actually returned the response
Outgoing requests omit prefix-bound reasoning blocks when Live context changes, retaining conversation text, tool calls and tool results; saved history is not mutated
A new request clears the stale frontend error banner without deleting historical errors
provider.production_diagnostic: The previously failing real QA history contained 10 reasoning blocks. The corrected request path succeeded inside the production task through Sonnet 4.6 after primary-model unavailability, without executing any Ableton actions.
provider.disabled_candidate: Sonnet 5.5 worked under the local operator credentials but the production task was refused with INVALID_PAYMENT_INSTRUMENT for its Marketplace subscription. It is not configured. Its four temporary IAM resources were removed; the existing role policy was preserved.
provider.limits: Fallback cannot guarantee availability during an AWS-wide outage and does not bypass authentication, bad-request or rate-limit errors.

tests.container_runtime: Passed real four-stem separation, aligned outputs, audible comparison previews and owner-scoped chat storage
tests.production_public_browser: 1440px and 390px: login, signup, password reset, guide and changelog return 200 with no page errors, broken assets or horizontal overflow. Invalid sign-in shows readable validation; logged-out dashboard redirects to login.
tests.protected_api_routes: Unauthenticated chats and Bridge status return 401

live_qa.audio_checks: Actual browser playback advances; decoded previews contain signal without clipping. Approval persists after reload, does not send another chat request, and leaves audio paused.
live_qa.preservation: Saved ALS comparison confirms kick MIDI notes, sample paths and mixer volume are identical before and after bass creation; Bass changes from zero to 16 notes.
live_qa.follow_up: A subsequent no-edit chat request correctly named Kick and Bass as accepted, with no Ableton tools or audition.
live_qa.failures_before_fixes: Two initial Opus 503 interruptions and one later invalid thinking-signature rejection; no Ableton actions began in those failed requests. Their historical logs remain intact.

preservation.music: Original saved set retained as Before Launch QA 2026-10-02. Disposable QA saved separately; original AbletonOSC directory restored after the clean-integration test.
preservation.configuration: Existing payment, secret references, IAM policy, storage mounts and ECS role settings preserved. Runtime changes are release identity, fallback model and retry count only.
preservation.release_contents: No marketing music, videos, QA recordings, chats, credentials or replay scripts included in release commits or installer assets.
preservation.rollback: Previous immutable installer and tasks retained; frontend snapshots at releases/before-20261002-dda73c9c/ and releases/before-20261002-7a64c07f/.

remaining_launch_checks: Independent first-time installation on another supported Apple Silicon Mac with fresh privacy permissions has not been performed. This Mac already had those permissions.
Payment completion remains explicitly deferred by the user; no Stripe payment was initiated and payment settings were unchanged. AI test requests consume provider usage.
Reset email was accepted by SMTP in the preceding audit; recipient confirmation of this test message and its button is still unverified.
Full-song separation quality, subjective musical quality, every third-party plug-in, Intel Macs and Windows are not established by this audit.
